name: Bug eyed
summary: Eyes that all look the same way: their gaze wanders, darts on the music and often turns to stare at you; they blink on the beat. Cartoon eyeballs, or real eyes traced like the real thing.
credit: After vizz.fm's Bug Eyed (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Every eye watches the same point, which drifts, darts on sharp sounds (Darting) and turns to look at you (Stare). Each beat makes some eyes blink; the bass widens the pupils. Style: Cartoon is the original bug eyes, each swelling with its own band; Real traces each eye like a real one (cornea, iris, wet white, lids).

params.label: Style
params.help: Cartoon: the bug eyes, flat and bold. Real: eyes traced like the real thing.
